review_method: Actual Codex in-app browser screenshots and SVG DOM bounds for every produced panel; local stage crops change only viewBox.
observations: Selecting the canonical evidence frontier before stage compilation restores conditional branch detail. Stage-disabled and stage-enabled automatic open lists match across generic combinations and budgets.
ForeignComposition returns from 34 nodes / 35 edges to 28 / 30, crossings 6 to 3, by avoiding a presentation-induced budget shift.
The same manual Transformer open list has 102 nodes / 107 edges before and after. Branch columns, context channels and independent-entry alignment are restored; crossings fall 81 to 57.
The manually opened Transformer is now 2588 x 4502px, versus 2332 x 5456px before. Its unfolded Add and LayerNorm remain distinct inside the semantic stage.
ContextWeave and BoundaryWeave manual frontiers now match the automatic layouts byte-for-byte, with heights reduced by 92px and no new crossings.
Actual editor save/reopen/refold/all-expand preserves the IR, proof ownership, exact operands and stage cuts. Node sequence is 11,13,13,11,15.
The dedicated expanded reference remains more compact and more clearly organized. Generic folding and layout still do not establish role/frontier equivalence.
tradeoffs: ConditionalTail exposes four more nodes and two more edges than the prior presentation-affected budget. Height grows 812 to 1176px and crossings 2 to 4; the restored internal conditional computation and applied bypass are intentional evidence detail, not geometry improvement.
Manual canvas unfolding now runs bounded measured layout candidates, which adds computation. The large evaluation input still has 57 crossings and long context wires.
Actual node offsets continue to bypass geometry refinement; this round does not improve layouts with manually moved nodes. Print policy and explicit candidate settings remain in force.
TailMosaic and InterruptedTail each retain one pre-existing final bypass conflict. No stage receipt claims that preliminary routing success is final.
The fix restores layout optimization for a chosen frontier, but does not guarantee that every local expansion preserves all positions or reduces crossings.
